Cookie Policy for HelptrickBD.com

Last Updated: 08-01-2026

This Cookie Policy explains how HelptrickBD.com uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience. By using our website, you agree to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, mobile, tablet) when you visit a website. They help websites function properly, remember user preferences, and analyze browsing activity.

2. How We Use Cookies

HelptrickBD.com uses cookies for the following purposes:

  • Essential Cookies: Required for the core functioning of the website. Without these, certain features may not work properly.
  • Performance & Analytics Cookies: Used to analyze how users interact with our website, which helps us improve user experience. We may use tools such as Google Analytics to understand traffic patterns.
  • Functionality Cookies: Help remember user preferences such as language, display settings, and saved pages.

3. Advertising Cookies (Google AdSense)

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve personalized ads based on your browsing behavior and interests.

Google uses the DoubleClick DART Cookie to show ads tailored to users based on their visits to HelptrickBD.com and other websites.

Users may opt out of Google’s personalized advertising by visiting:
👉 Google Ads Settings

4. Third-Party Cookies

In addition to our own cookies, third-party services such as Google Analytics, Google AdSense, social media platforms, or embedded content may set their own cookies.

We do not control third-party cookies. Users should review the cookie policies of the respective third-party platforms for more details.

5. Managing & Disabling Cookies

You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings:

  • Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies
  • Firefox: Preferences → Privacy & Security → Cookies
  • Edge: Settings → Site permissions → Cookies
  • Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Cookies

Please note: Disabling cookies may affect website performance and certain features may not work correctly.

6. Consent & Children's Privacy

By continuing to use HelptrickBD.com, you consent to our use of cookies as described in this Cookie Policy. If you do not agree, you should adjust your browser settings or stop using the website.

Children's Privacy: HelptrickBD.com does not knowingly use cookies to collect data from children under 13. If you believe such data has been collected, please contact us for immediate removal.

7. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with the updated “Last Updated” date. Users are encouraged to review this page periodically.

Contact Information

For questions or concerns regarding this Cookie Policy, please contact us:

Email: helptrick24bd@gmail.com

Thank you for using HelptrickBD.com!

item.title: গোপনীয়তা নীতি (Privacy Policy)
item.dc:creator: ayesha
item.content:encoded:
Effective Date: January 1, 2026
Last Updated: September 14, 2026

Welcome to HelpTrickBD (https://www.helptrickbd.com/). At HelpTrickBD, we respect the privacy of our visitors and are deeply committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy document explains what types of information are collected and recorded by HelpTrickBD and how we utilize it.

If you have additional questions or require more information regarding our Privacy Policy, please feel free to reach out to us via our Contact Us page or email us directly at support@helptrickbd.com.

1. Consent

By accessing or using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to abide by its terms and conditions.

2. Information We Collect

When you visit HelpTrickBD, we may collect information in several ways:

  • Direct Interactions: When you leave a comment on our articles, subscribe to our newsletter, or submit a query through our contact form, we may ask for details such as your name, email address, and message contents.
  • Log Files: Like standard web hosting and blogging platforms, HelpTrickBD follows standard logging procedures. These files record visitors when they visit websites. The information collected by log files includes internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable.

3. Cookies and Web Beacons

Like any other website, HelpTrickBD uses "cookies". These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users' experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors' browser type and/or other information.

4. Google DoubleClick DART Cookie & Google AdSense

Google is one of the third-party vendors on our site. It also uses cookies, known as DART cookies, to serve ads to our site visitors based upon their visit to www.helptrickbd.com and other sites on the internet.

  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to our users based on their visit to our sites and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.
  • Alternatively, you can opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting aboutads.info.

5. Third-Party Advertising Partners

Some of the advertisers on our site may use cookies and web beacons. Our primary advertising partner is Google AdSense. Third-party ad servers or ad networks use technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on HelpTrickBD, which are sent directly to users' browsers. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit.

Note: HelpTrickBD has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.

6. GDPR Data Protection Rights

We would like to make sure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Every user is entitled to the following:

  • The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
  • The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate.
  • The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to restrict or object to processing – You have the right to request restriction or object to our processing of your personal data.

7. CCPA Privacy Rights (Do Not Sell My Personal Information)

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California consumers have the right to:

  • Request that a business disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal data that a business has collected about consumers.
  • Request that a business delete any personal data about the consumer that a business has collected.
  • Request that a business that sells a consumer's personal data, not sell the consumer's personal data. (HelpTrickBD never sells personal data to third parties).

8. Children's Information (COPPA)

Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity. HelpTrickBD does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

9. Updates to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, we advise you to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

10. Contact Information

If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:

  • Website: HelpTrickBD
  • Contact Page: https://www.helptrickbd.com/contact-us/
  • Email: support@helptrickbd.com

item.title: আমাদের সম্পর্কে (About Us)
item.dc:creator: ayesha
item.content:encoded:
About HelpTrickBD - Learn Smart

Welcome to HelpTrickBD (www.helptrickbd.com), a dedicated digital learning and educational resource platform in Bangladesh. Founded with a vision to make academic studies and competitive exam preparation accessible, comprehensive, and simple, HelpTrickBD offers reliable, thoroughly researched, and high-quality study materials for students across universities, colleges, and national curriculums.

Our Mission & Vision

In today's fast-paced educational landscape, students often struggle to find clear, authentic, and syllabus-oriented notes. Our mission is to bridge this gap by delivering structured, easy-to-understand educational content that empowers learners to excel in their academic and competitive pursuits.

  • Authenticity & Depth: Delivering comprehensive notes backed by historical records, academic textbooks, and verified references.
  • Free & Accessible Knowledge: Ensuring quality educational resources remain freely accessible to students from all corners of Bangladesh.
  • Smart Learning Methods: Breaking down complex socio-political, economic, and historical concepts into digestible points, comparative tables, and structured summaries.

Key Subject Areas We Cover

Our editorial focus is structured around core disciplines where students require in-depth conceptual clarity:

  1. Political Science & Governance: Concepts of statehood, sovereignty (সার্বভৌমত্ব), constitution, public policy, welfare states, and national political dynamics.
  2. Economics & National Development: Bangladesh's economic trends, budget analysis, remittance dynamics, inflation control, and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  3. History & Social Welfare: Contributions of prominent social reformers, national liberation struggles, historical movements, and sociological frameworks.
  4. Academic & Competitive Exam Preparation: Degree, Honours, Masters, SSC, Alim, and BCS foundational study guides and syllabus walkthroughs.

Our Editorial Standards & Quality Assurance

At HelpTrickBD, every article undergoes careful research, fact-checking, and structured formatting before publication. We strongly advocate for educational integrity and adhere to the highest editorial guidelines:

  • Zero Tolerance for Plagiarism: Every post is written from scratch with genuine analytical insights.
  • Continuous Review & Updating: Academic facts, policies, and examination routines are constantly updated to ensure relevancy.
  • User-Centric Feedback: We actively listen to our readers' suggestions and clarify queries through our comments and contact channels.

Connect With Us

We are always eager to collaborate with educators, researchers, and fellow students. If you have any inquiries, suggestions, or feedback, please reach out to us:

  • Website: https://www.helptrickbd.com/
  • Email: support@helptrickbd.com / contact@helptrickbd.com
  • Contact Page: Contact Us
